annotation.title_clean: Safety-Relevant Guidance for On-Road Testing of Prototype Automated Driving System (ADS)-Operated Vehicles (SAE J3018_202012)
annotation.title_en: Safety-Relevant Guidance for On-Road Testing of Prototype Automated Driving System (ADS)-Operated Vehicles (SAE J3018_202012)
annotation.summary_en: SAE J3018 (Dec 2020 revision) is a voluntary technical standard giving safety guidance for on-road testing of prototype Level 3–5 automated driving system vehicles. It covers training for in-vehicle fallback test drivers and how they oversee testing. Remote driving, Level 1–2 features, closed-course, simulation and component testing are out of scope.
key_provisions_or_claims: Gives safety guidance for on-road testing of prototype Level 3–5 ADS vehicles as defined in SAE J3016
Sets out training guidance for in-vehicle fallback test drivers (IFTD)
Leaves out remote fallback test driving, Level 1–2 features, closed-course, simulation and component-level testing
Points users to legal and risk issues in data collection: auditable procedures, privacy law, and recording integrity for crash forensics
